verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets users write YAML workflows that are syntax-compatible with GitHub Actions and reuse existing Actions, which is a first-party, event-triggered automation engine (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15, gitea-docs-33). Webhooks add event-driven custom workflows (gitea-docs-4). However, the specific trigger events and rule semantics are only implied by the GitHub Actions compatibility, not spelled out. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported trigger events and conditions, non-CI rule automation (e.g., issue/PR automation rules), independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered workflows.
